text_blocks.snippet: A cross is a geometrical figure made of two intersecting lines or bars, usually perpendicular to each other, and serves as the primary universal symbol of Christianity.
snippet_highlighted_words: a geometrical figure made of two intersecting lines or bars, usually perpendicular to each other

list.snippet: Geometrical Shape: Two lines or bars crossing each other at right angles (like a plus sign or a standard Latin cross) or oblique angles like a saltire.
Religious Symbol: An instrument of ancient Roman crucifixion that represents the crucifixion of Jesus and core Christian beliefs.
State of Mind: An adjective meaning annoyed, angry, or peeved.
Premise: A gritty crime thriller series on Prime Video following Washington, D.C., homicide detective and forensic psychologist Alex Cross.
Source Material: Based on the bestselling book series by James Patterson.
Cast: Stars Aldis Hodge as Alex Cross and Isaiah Mustafa as his partner John Sampson.
